Reach is capped

Each reel reaches about 5.5k people

Your last seven reels averaged 5.5k views. That's a strong, loyal audience, but it's the same audience every time, and growth depends on the algorithm picking the next one up.

Press doesn't convert

NYT, HuffPost and Cosmo readers land nowhere

The press builds trust, but a reader who finds you has no simple first step. They either apply for private coaching or they scroll away.

Content treadmill

1,449 posts and six this week

Lead flow still leans on the next post. When you travel, rest or run an event, new conversations slow down with you.

The daters and couples who love your content but aren't ready to apply have nowhere to say a small yes, so most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass built on "Let's plan yours", with a toolkit straight after checkout

You already have the audience, the press and the credential. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that shows daters and couples how you help them plan their love life on purpose, offers a low-ticket toolkit on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply on the replay. Meta ads put that class in front of new daters and couples every day, and the $17 seats and toolkit sales help fund the ads.

Audience + Meta ads18.9k on Instagram, press and podcast reach, plus new reach from ads

Sound familiar?

You plan everything else. Why not your love life?

  • You're dating with intention, or you're in a relationship you care about, and you want love to feel less like guesswork.
  • You've read the articles and listened to the podcasts, and you still end up in the same patterns.
  • Dating apps feel like a second job, or date night has quietly turned into a chat about logistics.
  • You'd love a clear plan for your love life, the way you'd plan anything else that matters to you.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

Why love drifts onto autopilot

What's really happening when dating feels repetitive or a relationship slips into routine, and why trying harder rarely changes it.

02

Know what you actually want

A simple way to name what matters to you in love, so you stop deciding on chemistry or habit alone.

03

The conversations that move things forward

How to start the talks most people avoid, whether it's a third date or year ten, without it feeling heavy.

04

Plan the adventure

Ally walks you through building your own Love Plan live: the dates, rituals and next steps that make love intentional.

05

Your next step

How working with Ally works, so you can choose the support that fits where you are.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Love on autopilot"

Hook
"You plan your career, your calendar, even your weekends. So why does love get left on autopilot?" (to camera, white shirt, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"Whether you're dating or you've been together for years, most of us leave love on autopilot and hope it works out. The couples and daters I see thrive do one thing differently: they plan. They know what they want, they have the talks that matter, and they keep it an adventure." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach exactly how in a 60-minute class called The Love Plan. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for your love life"

Hook
"Dating or partnered, ask yourself these three questions this week." (Ally holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what do I actually want love to feel like? Two: which conversation have I been putting off? Three: when did I last plan something just for us, or just for me as a dater?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I turn your answers into a real plan in my class, The Love Plan. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me where to start: my posts, my Ask Me Anything, or coaching with me. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, come to my class first. You'll see how I think about love, build your own Love Plan, and know whether going deeper with me is right for you."
CTA
"It's called The Love Plan, it's $17, and there's a replay. Tap Sign up."
